userStandard: 在系统最大辅助功能字号下验证诊断信息显示、复制及返回。
scope: iOS simulator diagnostics page; no account/token fixtures
requiredObservations: Read and retain the actual system preferred content-size category; it must be the largest accessibility category supported by the frozen OS. Merely setting a command flag is not evidence.
Observe the installed candidate and diagnostics page with fresh device/Run/build-bound observations and screenshot/accessibility references.
Version, build and environment labels and values must be readable completely; scrolling is allowed, clipping/overlap/ellipsis that hides content is a failure.
Copy control remains reachable; clipboard contains exactly the three expected installed-app fields and no other account/token values.
Back control remains reachable and returns to settings.

outcomes.passed: All required observations present, bound to the candidate and maximal size; all five user criteria still hold.
outcomes.failed: Observed clipping, unreadable/overlapping content, unreachable action, wrong clipboard or wrong destination.
outcomes.blocked: Font state, foreground identity, installed bytes, observation or clipboard cannot be independently confirmed.

cleanup: Restore the prior simulator content-size setting; failure keeps the resource quarantined.
provenance: User standard plus deterministic implementation mapping; not a device result or signed rubric deployment.
